policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="rpc-id" value="@{
            try {
                var id = context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true)["id"];
                return id != null && id.Type == JTokenType.String ? id.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None) : "";
            } catch { return ""; }
        }" />
        
            
                @{
                    var body = context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
                    body["id"] = 1;
                    return body.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
                }

outbound.choose:
<when condition="@(((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("rpc-id", "")).Length > 0)">
                @{
                    var original = JToken.Parse((string)context.Variables["rpc-id"]);
                    var text = context.Response.Body.As();
                    var isStream = context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Content-Type", "").StartsWith("text/event-stream");
                    var lines = isStream ? text.Split('\n') : new[] { "data: " + text };
                    for (var i = 0; i < lines.Length; i++) {
                        var line = lines[i].TrimEnd('\r');
                        if (!line.StartsWith("data:")) { continue; }
                        var json = line.Substring(5).Trim();
                        if (!json.StartsWith("{")) { continue; }
                        var msg = JObject.Parse(json);
                        if (msg["id"] != null) { msg["id"] = original; }
                        lines[i] = (isStream ? "data: " : "") + msg.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
                    }
                    return string.Join("\n", lines);
                }
